capabilities: Convert Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML with inline styles
Highlight code blocks with inlined colors
Inline local and wikilink images as base64
Preview the rendered article in a phone frame
Copy the rendered article as rich text for pasting
disambiguation: Not a visual theme designer; it converts existing Markdown into WeChat-ready HTML and copies it out.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; only manual installation from GitHub Releases is available. A future API mode pushing to the WeChat draft box is mentioned for certified accounts. Carries the standard unreviewed-plugin notice.
motivation: The author built it around a copy-mode workflow because personal unverified subscription accounts cannot pass WeChat certification and get error 48001 from the draft API, so a zero-setup local render-copy-paste flow works on any account.
problem: WeChat's article editor strips most formatting, its draft API rejects unverified personal accounts (error 48001), and there is no built-in way to get styled Markdown content into it.
summary: Converts Markdown notes into inline-styled WeChat-compatible HTML, previews them in a phone frame, and copies them for pasting into the WeChat editor.
